assessment.rationale: No open or discoverable ledger traces donations to verified outcomes, so the Main KPI of 500,000,000 donations traced to outcomes is unmet. The best-known outcome estimates are model-based, not traced: GiveWell builds program-level cost-effectiveness models (top charities roughly 3,500 to 5,500 US dollars per life saved on 2021 figures) with external-validity adjustments and subjective moral weights, notes a past estimate about 100 times off, and does not link a specific donor's dollar to a specific result (https://www.givewell.org/how-we-work/our-criteria/cost-effectiveness). A 2025 evidence gap map of results-based payments shows uneven evidence (https://doi.org/10.1057/s41287-025-00713-9), aid-data governance stays fragmented across regimes such as IATI (https://doi.org/10.17645/pag.10508), and blockchain donation-tracking designs are proposals that trace money, not impact (https://doi.org/10.1002/sd.3260). GitHub holds two small donation-tracking projects. Honest limit: tracing financial flows (IATI publishing, blockchain ledgers, outcome-based contracts) is known and is not new work; the unsolved part is causal attribution of outcomes to marginal dollars with verification, so tasks must target a checkable piece such as a verifiable outcome-attestation protocol tested on real programme data.

additionalSearches.query: philanthropy impact measurement donation outcome tracing blockchain transparency (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 23 works: Routledge Handbook of AI and Philanthropy (2024), a blockchain framework for crowdfunding SDG projects (2024), zakat management model (2025). Designs, not an operating outcome ledger.

additionalSearches.query: cost-effectiveness charity evaluation GiveWell outcome attribution per dollar (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 6 works: the charity capacity curse (2025), bias against horizontal interventions in cost-effectiveness (2025), communicating global income rank. No per-donation outcome tracing.
2 repositories, 0 stars: a student animal-adoption donation ledger and an African giving platform. Null result for an open outcome-tracing ledger.

additionalSearches.query: IATI aid transparency results data traceability evaluation (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 37 works: fragmented aid-data governance (2025), transparency and austerity survey experiment (2025). Aid flows are published; outcomes are not traced to funds.

additionalSearches.query: outcome-based funding social impact bond results verified payment evaluation (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 5,241 works: social impact bond outcome payments (2025), UK and Germany SIB studies, a 2025 evidence gap map on results-based payments. Outcome contracting exists at small scale.

Program-level models of cost per life or life-year; roughly $3,500-5,500 per life saved (2021); external-validity and subjective adjustments; one past error about 100x; no tracing of individual donations.
